display_alias: Lobby/title screen background — four heroes, feudal-Japan courtyard, baked title lettering

prompt_edit_lineage: art/source/title_screen/nano_banana_prompt.txt -> approved.jpg (Nano Banana 2, single generation, approved as-is)
source.note: Generated externally via Nano Banana 2 (gemini-3.1-flash-image) by Philip, per the design decision that Claude Code has no image-generation tool in this session and Gemini image generation has no free API tier. Prompt built from the real per-hero visual spec in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-25-art-direction-and-runtime-asset-integration.md (fire: male, orange topknot, orange ember-cracked armor, flaming saber; water: blue hair, teal/dark-blue robe; earth: brown hair, stone-fleck armor, summoning rock spikes; wind: female, pale-cyan hair, pale robe with dark outline, fans) even though the style itself (realistic 3D anime) deliberately departs from the game's in-game chibi sprite style -- Philip's explicit choice after being flagged the tonal mismatch.

pillow.contract: tools/art/title_screen_pipeline.py center-crops the 2752x1536 source to exactly 16:9 and downscales to 1920x1080 JPEG (quality 88).

design.strategy_rationale: Title/lobby art has no gameplay-legibility constraint (unlike ground.png), so a single generated key-art image is sufficient -- no procedural generation or contrast gate applies here.
design.css_fit_note: client/index.html uses background-size: contain (NOT cover) with a solid #1a1712 letterbox colour, because the title lettering is baked into the image itself -- cover would crop it off-screen on any viewport not exactly 16:9. The DOM <h1> title text is kept but visually hidden (clip-rect technique) so screen-reader users still get a text title, since the image conveys none to them.

runtime.note: Referenced directly as a CSS background-image on #lobby in client/index.html (not registered in client/src/assets/manifest.js -- it's a plain HTML/CSS background, not a Phaser texture).

qa.evidence: Verified live in the browser preview at both a narrow (~800x721) and wide (1440x900) viewport: full title text stays in frame at both via letterboxing, form controls stay readable over the dark scrim.
qa.gate: manual only -- no automated test covers this asset.
